contents.text: Added Sandstone Pick and Sandstone Pickaxe
Added Sandstone Armour which cools the wearer slightly
Vanilla armour now increases temperature, with leather having the highest impact
Rebalanced sources of high temperature: burning, sprinting, proximity to fire and campfires
Greatly rebalanced underground temperatures (subject to further changes)
Rotten Flesh can now be smoked (campfire, smoker) for leather and smelted (furnace) for Medium Rare Rotten Flesh

Fixed Bugs:
Extreme Heat Damage is classified as freezing
Hydration can exceed its maximum value
